name: New America Acquisition I Corp.
summary: New America Acquisition I Corp. is dedicated to finalizing a substantial business combination, which may take the form of a merger, an amalgamation, an exchange of shares, an asset acquisition, a share purchase, a corporate reorganization, or similar strategic alliance. Its target enterprises are primarily found within the technology, healthcare, and logistics industries. This entity was founded in 2025 and operates from its base in New York, New York.
